title: spring.webhook
description: Two buckets: spring.webhook.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.webhook.instances.<name> holds one entry per named instance. No other key belongs directly under spring.webhook.

instances.description: One entry per instance; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

url.description: webhook endpoint the notification is POSTed to

channel.description: payload format / signing scheme of the receiver

secret.description: DingTalk 加签 secret (SEC...) or Feishu signing secret; ignored by other channels
